description: Source code for AFM (Adobe Font Metrics) parser in the FreeType project, handling reading and parsing AFM font metric data from files.

classes.name: AFM_StreamRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a stream for reading AFM data, including cursor position and status.

classes.name: AFM_Parser
classes.description: Parser context for AFM font metrics, including associated stream and font info.

methods.name: afm_stream_skip_spaces
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in the AFM stream, updating stream status accordingly.

methods.name: afm_stream_read_one
methods.description: Reads a single token (key or value) from the AFM stream.

methods.name: afm_stream_read_string
methods.description: Reads a string (up to end of line) from the AFM stream.

methods.name: afm_parser_read_vals
methods.description: Reads multiple values from the AFM stream into provided variables.

methods.name: afm_parser_next_key
methods.description: Retrieves the next key in the AFM data, either line-based or column-based.

methods.name: afm_tokenize
methods.description: Converts a key string into a token enum for easier processing.

methods.name: afm_parser_init
methods.description: Initializes the AFM parser with a memory context and data buffer.

methods.name: afm_parser_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the AFM parser.

methods.name: afm_parser_read_int
methods.description: Reads an integer value from the AFM stream.

methods.name: afm_parse_track_kern
methods.description: Parses track kerning data from AFM.

methods.name: afm_compare_kern_pairs
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting kerning pairs.

methods.name: afm_parse_kern_pairs
methods.description: Parses kerning pairs from AFM data.

methods.name: afm_parse_kern_data
methods.description: Parses kerning data section from AFM.

methods.name: afm_parser_skip_section
methods.description: Skips over a section of AFM data until a specified end token.

methods.name: afm_parser_parse
methods.description: Main function to parse AFM font metrics data.
